title: Sukuwareru Ramiris
content:
Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken was ... let's say something of note, but I'm not gonna talk about it today, this is more focused on this bundle of shorts around the same goofy, slice of life, fan-favorite comfort show, at around 2 minutes per episode, it does not overstay its welcome nor does it leave you thirsting for more, just like a passing ghosty too transparent to give notice, it slips by your memory- let's just say this is one of those forgettable shows that you'll completely erase from your head of ever even hearing about it, but really sink into your seat while watchingit. It's very inoffensive and laid-back.

What's shocking was that the animation quality is on par with the main series, bright and colorful colors that are not too hard on the eye.
